content:
We at Cajal are happy to introduce you to Talos, a framework for formal verification of WebAssembly modules in Lean 4.

We provide a Wasm interpreter optimized for reasoning, together with a WP calculus layer for proving properties about programs.

See the proof that the gcd algorithm using Stein's algorithm, implemented in the popular crate num-integer, is correct.

Because we reason directly about WebAssembly, any language with a Wasm backend is in scope: Rust, C++, Go, C, Swift, Kotlin, Zig, C#, and many more.

The project is early-stage and our current goals are:

  • Full Wasm coverage by passing the official testsuite
  • Arbitrary crate verification — any Rust crate that compiles to Wasm should be in scope
  • A growing proof library that makes verifying increasingly complex programs tractable

This is a great time to get involved and help shape the library. If you're interested in contributing, come say hi!
